body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its 8-inch digital photo frame ‘SPF-83V' during KES 2007, which features WiFi connection. Supporting video/mp3 playback, built-in 64MB flash memory, 4-in-1 memory(SD/MMC/MS/XD) card reader and CF card slot, it is expected to be released in Korea market in October. Suggested price is 230,000(KRW).
